title: Exclusive off-course totalizator licence (New South Wales)
summary: The Totalizator Act 1997 (NSW) entitles the TAB to the off-course totalizator licence and bars anyone else from one during the exclusivity period.
direction_rationale: An exclusive licence keeps all other totalizator operators out.

verified.notes: An existing setting: no dates. Quoted from the Open Australian Legal Corpus copy of January 2023 (not itself official).

review.notes: Drafted by AI-assisted desk research on 17 November 2026 (phase 6 of the levers re-evaluation, batch 1) from the law quoted. Not yet checked: verify the description, industries and assessment before use.

assessment.summary: Only the TAB may hold the off-course totalizator licence during the exclusivity period. A statutory exclusive right to pool betting off course.

marks.reason: No other person may be licensed to run an off-course totalizator during the exclusivity period.
Shelters the TAB's pool betting from rival totalizators, though fixed-odds bookmakers compete.

assessment.confidence_note: The exclusivity is explicit; its end date depends on a gazetted operative date, not quoted here.
